A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we present a new method for parsing languages with small annotated corpus which is based on a morphosytnactic lattice structure and which is able to produce a high parsing accuracy.

we have shown that the use of a lattice structure for dependency parsing of resource-poor languages is beneficial, especially when we have a good language model and a good Dependency Insertion Grammar.
we propose a new method of parsing for languages with small corpus which is based on the lattice factorization of the input.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of lattice structures for dependency parsing can be a good alternative to the methods of morphosyntactically analyzing resource poor languages.
it is possible to obtain a good parsing accuracy even when the quality of the input from morphosyntactic analyzers is not very high.

it is feasible to use the k-best dependency parsing method on a morphosyndactic lattice structure for languages with very small annotated corpora and that it is possible to achieve good parsing accuracy with such an input.
